text: api.ts's openChatSocket() wraps the raw WebSocket and exposes only send()/close()/raw -- callers drive it via onEvent callbacks dispatching on a discriminated union WsEvent (stage | final | error), never by inspecting raw.readyState directly outside api.ts itself.
